---
title: "What do Europeans think of the EU?"
subtitle: "according to Eurobarometer 105.2 (March–April 2026)"
format: dashboard
theme: cosmo
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# cleaned data from scripts/clean_data.R
Data <- readRDS("data/process/eb_clean.rds")


Countries <- Data %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(positive = round(mean(eu_positive) * 100))

# % positive for each level of money trouble
Bills <- Data %>%
  filter(!is.na(bills)) %>% #filter out na responses
  group_by(bills) %>%
  summarise(positive = round(mean(eu_positive) * 100))

```

## Row {height="20%"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Number of people interviewed"
#| color: primary
list(value = nrow(Data)) 
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "How many have a positive image of the EU?"
#| color: success
positive <- round(mean(Data$eu_positive) * 100)
list(value = paste0(positive, "%"))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "How many trust the EU?"
#| color: warning
trust <- round(mean(Data$trust_eu) * 100)
list(value = paste0(trust, "%"))
```

## Row {height="80%"}

### Column {width="33%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Image of the EU"
Data %>%
  filter(!is.na(eu_image)) %>%
  count(eu_image) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(eu_image), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(x = "1 = very negative, 5 = very positive", y = "Number of people") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Column {width="33%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Positive image of the EU by country (%)"
ggplot(Countries, aes(x = reorder(country, positive), y = positive)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% positive") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Column {width="34%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Money trouble vs. EU image (people)"
ggplot(Bills, aes(x = bills, y = positive)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = bills), show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues", direction = -1) +
  labs(x = "Trouble paying bills (last 12 months)", y = "% positive image of the EU") +
  theme_minimal()
```
